xna-type.name: GeometryContent
xna-type.summary: Provides properties that define various aspects of a geometry batch.
xna-type.remarks: A geometry batch is a subcomponent of a mesh, representing a single piece of homogeneous geometry that can be submitted to the GPU in a single draw call. It contains an indexed triangle list (using a single material) where all vertices share the same set of data channels. Vertices are made unique if there are differences in any of their data channels. Coordinates that require unique vertices on either side of a join create unique vertices.

property.name: Indices
property.summary: Gets the list of triangle indices for this geometry batch. Geometry is stored as an indexed triangle list, where each group of three indices defines a single triangle.
property.remarks: Use these indices to reference into the collection of position indices and vertex channels of the geometry batch.

property.name: Material
property.summary: Gets or sets the material of the parent mesh.

property.name: Parent
property.summary: Gets or sets the parent MeshContent for this object.

property.name: Vertices
property.summary: Gets the set of vertex batches for the geometry batch.
